themes.description: This theme covers requests for new trading tools, charting functionalities, order placement methods, and other enhancements to the core trading experience.
This theme covers concerns related to data collection, app tracking, privacy policies, and transparency regarding user data.
This theme covers issues encountered during the account setup, registration, or ID creation process.
Reviews questioning the trustworthiness, reliability, or overall value proposition of the investment platform and its advice.
Feedback related to the frequency, relevance, or intrusiveness of advertisements.
Complaints related to the frequency, relevance, or nature of advertisements associated with the platform.
Covers general satisfaction with the app's overall quality, design, and the functionality of specific features like charts.
Covers issues related to the functionality, design, or availability of specific features within the application, such as charts, watchlists, or analytical tools.
Addresses issues related to app installation, uninstallation, persistent notifications, or unwanted app behavior on the device.
Overall user satisfaction, general positive or negative feedback about the application's core functionality and usefulness.
Complaints about absent or inadequate features, lack of customization options, or limitations in functionality.
Suggestions for improving the user interface or overall user experience of the application.
Reviews offering advice or warnings about specific financial products or features.
Suggestions for new features or enhancements to existing functionalities within the application.
This theme covers complaints related to the application's user interface, user experience, design patterns, and navigation. It includes issues like confusing layouts or deceptive design.
This theme covers issues related to adherence to financial regulations (e.g., SEBI rules), transparency in charges, and proper handling of funds including settlement and withdrawal timelines.
Concerns related to user control over investments, fund accessibility, or the operational model of investment products.
Reviews related to account access issues, security vulnerabilities, authentication methods, and unauthorized access concerns.
